label: Generate AI Video Clip
description: Generates an AI video clip from a shot's previs image using Veo 3.1.

characters.description: Only include characters whose names appear in the shot description text

locations.description: Include the location if it is referenced in the shot via a set-in binding

referenceInstruction: Using the attached reference images as visual guides for character appearance and location setting. The characters in this frame must match these references exactly — same face, hair, body type, clothing, and features. The environment should be consistent with the location reference.

sections.template: Style: Cinematic video footage shot on professional cinema camera. Smooth, naturalistic motion with 24fps film cadence. Rich color grading with deep shadows and controlled highlights.

frameSizeLensMap.WIDE: wide-angle lens (24mm), deep depth of field
frameSizeLensMap.EXTREME WIDE: ultra wide-angle lens (16mm), expansive depth of field
frameSizeLensMap.MEDIUM: standard lens (50mm), natural perspective with moderate depth of field
frameSizeLensMap.MEDIUM CLOSE-UP: 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field (f/2.8)
frameSizeLensMap.CLOSE-UP: 85mm portrait lens, very shallow depth of field (f/1.8)
frameSizeLensMap.EXTREME CLOSE-UP: macro lens (100mm), extremely shallow depth of field (f/1.4)

cameraMovementPromptMap.STATIC: Camera holds perfectly still on a locked-off tripod
cameraMovementPromptMap.PAN: Smooth horizontal pan following the action from left to right
cameraMovementPromptMap.TILT: Gentle vertical tilt upward revealing the scene
cameraMovementPromptMap.DOLLY: Dolly tracking shot pushing forward through the space
cameraMovementPromptMap.SLOW PUSH IN: Very subtle, barely perceptible dolly push-in
cameraMovementPromptMap.PUSH IN: Camera pushes in toward the subject, tightening the frame
cameraMovementPromptMap.PULL BACK: Camera slowly pulls back, revealing the wider scene
cameraMovementPromptMap.TRACKING: Camera tracks laterally alongside the moving subject
cameraMovementPromptMap.CRANE: Camera cranes upward with sweeping elevated perspective
cameraMovementPromptMap.HANDHELD: Handheld camera with organic, documentary-style movement
cameraMovementPromptMap.STEADICAM: Smooth floating Steadicam gliding through the space
